_comment: Base (8453) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Every address below was verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) on 2026-09-08. Two entries may share one `symbol` — native ETH and WETH both price off ETH/USD. Feeds present but not wired: BTC (cbBTC and WBTC carry their own), and SOL/BNB/XRP/ADA/AVAX/DOGE/LTC/POL/OP, none of which has a canonical ERC-20 on Base. USDbC is the bridged USD Base Coin and rides USDC/USD. Wrapped/bridged representations ride the base asset's feed: a depeg of the wrapper itself is outside what the oracle can see. That is the same trade-off already taken for WBTC on chains with no WBTC/USD feed.
